value.rationale: The mathematically motivated open-ended question is whether Minkowski-additive box regularization destroys a known rank-four Rayleigh counterexample. The exact four-weight defect and natural two-block classification exhibit a genuine nested false→true→false sign transition; in contrast all isotropic cubes preserve strict failure. This is a meaningful stability boundary and a counterexample to monotonic repair heuristics, not a reparameterization of a fixed-generator scale experiment. The exact threshold is a reusable stress test for Rayleigh zonotope-volume geometry.
